title: Use the same prompt and the same source assets when comparing Seedance2.0 4K vs…
content:
Use the same prompt and the same source assets when comparing Seedance2.0 4K vs 1080p outputs to isolate resolution differences.  
For Seedance2.0 4K results, view on a 4K-capable large screen/monitor (or set playback to 2160p) to properly evaluate detail and impact.  
Use Seedance2.0 4K for client work, product ads needing fine detail, film/drama production, or contest submissions where maximum quality matters despite higher credits.  
Combine Seedance2.0 4K with GPT Image 2 to generate a character sheet and storyboard, then use them to supplement/refine prompts for higher-quality video output.
